description: This class is a validator for Connection ID patterns within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically validating connection IDs based on a pattern defined in ConnectionId. It extends an abstract pattern validator, providing instance creation and validation logic.

classes.name: ConnectionIdPatternValidator
classes.description: A final immutable class that extends AbstractPatternValidator to validate Connection IDs based on a specific regex pattern.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of ConnectionIdPatternValidator for a given ID.

methods.name: ConnectionIdPatternValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator with the ID, pattern, and error message.

calls: super(id, ConnectionId.ID_PATTERN, "The given identifier is not valid.")
